name: develop-task-resume-dirty-tree-untracked-halts
description: Phase 0b working-tree probe (task.124 / obs #85, review Q5): the tree carries one tracked file identical to origin/develop AND one untracked file the base does not have. `git diff --quiet $BASE_REF -- <path>` never reports an untracked path, so the tracked-file test alone would pass it as overlay and `git clean` would delete real work. The `??` entry fails `git cat-file -e $BASE_REF:<path>` → classification (c) → HALT with the entries printed. Nothing is discarded; the halt snapshot records halt_reason dirty-tree; the lock is removed (two-command form); the pipeline does not proceed.
prompt: Re-invoke /develop-task for task.42.example after a HALT. The working tree carries an untracked file origin/develop does not have. Resume from the last completed step.
